results.label: scam

results.label: scam
results.text: Congratulations, you have been selected to receive a $9,000 federal community grant. There is nothing to repay. A $150 verification fee by prepaid card is required to release the funds.
results.summary: You were not selected for a free $9,000 grant — this is an advance-fee scam; real federal grants never require a $150 prepaid-card fee to release funds.
